text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
About that cutting-edge AI-equipped 
machine I mentioned before. It was just 
installed at my relative's gym the other 
day.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...? ...Ah, oh! You mean they put together 
a customized menu for each person...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You seemed interested in it. —It's a 
birthday present.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes—... Huh, what?! Wait, wh-what did you 
just say...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I have requested a full day of 
unrestricted access. I shall accompany you 
to ensure maximum efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, o-oh, you mean...! U-Um... well, I'm 
very grateful, but... It's... way too good 
for someone like meâ

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Cheval. As you push even 
further forward, I'll support you with all 
I've got."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You want to become stronger, don't you? It 
shows clearly in your efforts.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want... to become strong...! Please... 
take care of me, ngh...!
